entry.welcome.what.text: Veyora saves your passwords and private notes in an encrypted vault protected by your master password.

entry.welcome.vault.text: A vault is the encrypted container for your items. Encryption and decryption happen in this app; the service stores only ciphertext.

entry.welcome.mode.text: Mode: connected vault — items are encrypted on this device and synced to your Veyora service.

entry.create.explainStorage.text: Storage: items are encrypted in this browser and stored as ciphertext on the connected Veyora service.

entry.create.explainPassword.text: Password: use at least {min} characters. Length matters more than symbols.

entry.create.explainScreening.text: Common-password check: Veyora compares your password against a small built-in list on this device. It is never sent anywhere.

entry.create.errCommon.text: This password is built from a very common one. Add length with words only you would combine.

entry.create.explainRecovery.text: Recovery: there is no recovery path in this preview. If you forget this password, the vault cannot be reopened.

entry.create.explainBackup.text: Backups: encrypted backups are not available in this preview. CSV exports are plaintext and are not backups.

connect.sub.text: This Veyora service requires a connected session before a vault can be created or unlocked.

connect.tokenPh.text: Paste the token from your operator

connect.tokenHelp.text: Enter the connection credential issued by your service operator. Full device pairing arrives with connected mode.

connect.errEmpty.text: Enter both the service URL and the connection token.

connect.errWrong.text: The service rejected this connection token.

connect.errUnreachable.text: Could not reach the service at that address.

field.errNameRequired.text: Give this item a name so you can recognize it later — for example GitHub - Work.

field.errSecretRequired.text: Fill in this required field before saving, or use Generate to create a value.

modal.errSummaryTitle.text: Before saving, fix the highlighted fields:

toast.clipboardClearFailed.text: Could not clear the clipboard — it may be in use by another app.

save.statusNetwork.text: The vault was not changed — the service could not be reached. Your input is preserved here; retry the save when you are back online.

save.statusConflict.text: This item was changed on another device after you started editing, so your edit was not saved. Your edits are preserved here. Reload the latest version to start from it — reloading replaces the edits in this form.

save.statusOther.text: The vault was not changed — the save was rejected: {message}. Your input is preserved here; check the item and retry.

save.statusRequestId.text: If you report this problem, include request {id}.

modal.savedPending.text: Saved on this device — not yet on the service. It will sync automatically the next time the connection works.

modal.savedPendingDesktop.text: Saved on this device — the local vault did not respond. It will be saved automatically the next time it is reachable.

diag.storageValueDesktop.text: Encrypted vault stored on this device

diag.bundleSub.text: Opt-in and redacted: builds a diagnostic summary you preview before copying. Nothing is ever uploaded automatically.

diag.bundleIntro.text: Review the bundle below — it contains no secrets. Veyora never uploads it; copying is your decision.

field.tagsHint.text: Separate tags with commas; tags stay on this device and help you filter.

tags.none.text: No tagged items yet. Add tags under More fields when creating an item.

resetMatrix.title.text: Reset — choose exactly what to delete

resetMatrix.prefsSub.text: Clears theme, language, Trash retention, and checklist preferences stored on this device. Your vault and its data on the service are untouched.

resetMatrix.prefsDone.text: Preferences cleared — defaults apply the next time Veyora loads

resetMatrix.disconnectSub.text: Forgets the saved service address and connection token on this device. No vault data is deleted.

resetMatrix.disconnectDone.text: Saved connection cleared — applies the next time Veyora loads

resetMatrix.localSub.text: Removes this vault from this device, including offline queued writes. The encrypted copy on the service remains but can never be reached from this device again.

resetMatrix.localConfirm.text: Remove from this device? The service copy becomes unreachable

resetMatrix.everywhereSub.text: Deletes every record of this vault from the service first, then removes the vault from this device. This cannot be undone.

resetMatrix.everywhereConfirm.text: Delete everywhere? This cannot be undone

resetMatrix.everywhereDone.text: Vault deleted — {count} record(s) removed from the service and this device

resetMatrix.everywhereFailed.text: The service deletion failed — nothing was removed on this device

settings.changePwErrCommon.text: This password is built from very common material and is rejected locally.

settings.changePwErrMismatch.text: The new passwords do not match.

settings.changePwErrWrong.text: The current master password is wrong — nothing was changed.

settings.changePwErrPending.text: Offline writes are still pending — synchronize with the service before changing the password.

settings.changePwDone.text: Master password changed — every record was re-encrypted under the new key.

backup.body.text: The file contains every entry of this vault, encrypted under your master password with a key derived only for this backup. It restores on any device; without the master password its contents cannot be recovered by anyone.

backup.passwordHelp.text: Re-enter your master password to seal the backup.

backup.doneBody.text: The file holds {count} entr(y|ies), encrypted end to end.

backup.doneLocked.text: Keep the file and the master password together safely — only that password can open it.

backup.errWrong.text: That password does not open this vault or this backup — nothing was created.

backup.errFailed.text: The backup could not be created — nothing was downloaded.

backup.errFormat.text: That file is not a Veyora encrypted backup.

backup.restoreBody.text: The selected backup advertises {count} entr(y|ies). Enter the master password that sealed it to decrypt and merge them into this vault.

backup.restoreHelp.text: Existing entries are never overwritten: a restored id that already exists imports under a new id.

entry.recover.errFailed.text: Recovery failed — the vault was not changed. Check your connection and try again.

settings.regenSub.text: Generate a new Recovery Key; the previous one stops working immediately

regen.sub.text: A new Recovery Key is generated, the previous one is revoked, and a verified encrypted backup is created in the same step. You must store the new key before closing this dialog.

regen.doneConsequence.text: The previous Recovery Key no longer opens this vault. A verified encrypted backup of every entry was downloaded with this key.

regen.kitLabel.text: Your new Recovery Key — store it now

regen.verified.text: The downloaded backup was verified end to end before this dialog reported success.

kit.sub.text: This key is the only way back into your vault if the master password is lost. Save it now — Veyora cannot recover it for you.

kit.help.text: Write it down or store it in a separate password manager — not inside this vault.

kit.copied.text: Recovery Key copied — store it somewhere safe

kit.verifyLabel.text: Re-enter the key to prove you saved it

kit.errMismatch.text: That does not match this vault's Recovery Key — check your saved copy and try again.

kit.verified.text: Recovery Key verified — it is saved correctly

trash.purgeConfirm.text: Permanently delete {count} item(s)? This cannot be undone

trash.purgeNote.text: Deletes the encrypted copies from the service immediately — ahead of the retention window. Restoring them afterwards is impossible.
